The bug was caused by incorrectly modifying the `level` variable instead of the `ourlevel` variable when an invalid logging level was provided. This could lead to unintended behavior in the logging function, as the original `level` value would still be used in subsequent operations, potentially resulting in incorrect log levels being processed.

 void log_func_gnutls(int level, const char *message) {
         int ourlevel;
 
         assert_se(message);
 
         if (0 <= level && level < (int) ELEMENTSOF(log_level_map))
                 ourlevel = log_level_map[level];
         else
-                level = LOG_DEBUG;
+                ourlevel = LOG_DEBUG;
 
         log_meta(ourlevel, NULL, 0, NULL, "gnutls: %s", message);
 }
